title: Note on the launch of the Four Languages Blog: Letting the local 1.8B small model act as a translator
summary: The Chinese blogs are actually quite impressive. This time, I covered three languages: English, Japanese, and Korean—464 UI copy texts and 39 translation articles, all generated by a local small translation model with 1.8B parameters. We'll discuss architectural choices, translation pipeline setup, and some pitfalls only encountered when going live.
